map_forest.name: Forest Map
map_forest.description: A wooded country of oak, with berry bushes in the clearings. Wolves den here, and their Alpha keeps close.

map_mountain.name: Mountain Map
map_mountain.description: Rocky slopes seamed with copper and coal. Goblins camp on them, and their Chief keeps a tent of his own.

map_coast.name: Coast Map
map_coast.description: A sandy shore where the land meets the sea. Crabs scuttle on the rocks, and something stirs in a tide pool.

map_meadow.name: Meadow Map
map_meadow.description: Open grassland with apple trees, wild wheat and berry bushes, and a lake or river. Cows graze; a Greater Slime oozes about.

map_flower_meadow.name: Flower Meadow Map
map_flower_meadow.description: A meadow in bloom: strawberries, blueberries and the odd apple tree.

map_cherry_grove.name: Cherry Grove Map
map_cherry_grove.description: Cherry trees in rows, with a few peaches among them. Bees hum in a wild hive, and their Queen in a bigger one.

map_yellowstone.name: Yellowstone Map
map_yellowstone.description: Fir-clad hills around steaming sulphur springs, with wild grapevines on the slopes. Sulphur Lizards bask on the rocks; a Big Lizard keeps the warmest stone.

map_volcano.name: Volcano Map
map_volcano.description: Black rock and ash, rich in coal and iron. Fire Elementals flicker in the vents, and their Chief smoulders in a crater.

mod_overgrown.name: Overgrown
mod_overgrown.description: The woods run wild: many more oak trees.

mod_fir_grove.name: Fir Grove
mod_fir_grove.description: Firs grow where the oaks would: every oak becomes a fir.

map_bog.name: Bog Map
map_bog.description: Murky water, reeds and mist. Wild lavender grows on the hummocks and trout lurk in the pools; frogs croak everywhere, and one of them is poisonous.
